text:
Ravi: Morning team — I'm on until 16:00 UTC. Quick heads-up before I hand off later:

Ravi: Night deploy finished (~00:30 UTC). Post-deploy smoke was green, but saw a short KV eviction spike around 01:10 that auto-recovered. No user impact reported.

Ravi: Watchlist: embedding-service (us-east-1) p95 jumped to ~420ms overnight (baseline ~200ms). If p95 > 600ms for 5m, escalate to infra oncall and set fallback routing to embeddings-v2.

Ravi: Action items: ping reviewers on PR #3456 (canary routing). I left a short comment on the rollout toggle logic. Also linking dashboards and the lightweight runbook below.

Ravi: Dashboards: https://dash.redwood/ops/embeddings | Runbook: https://confluence/redwood/embeddings-runbook

oncall-bot: Rotation update — Ravi oncall until 16:00 UTC, Priya picks up 16:00–00:00 UTC. Reminder: page escalation policy v2 active.

Priya: Taking 16:00–00:00. I'll keep an eye on embeddings, thx for the links. I'll open a tiny sanity-check job that polls p95 every 2m and alerts if >600ms for 3 consecutive checks.

Priya: (quick runbook note) If we see persistent latency, try toggling to embeddings-v2 and bump batch size down to 8 for a test run.

Jun: FYI I noticed frontend 502s around 02:40 — autoscaler recovered a bad instance, looks like a short cache-priming storm. Not related to embeddings but wanted to call out.

Avery: I'll review PR #3456 in the next 30m and leave any blockers. If it looks ok, can merge and I'll monitor canary logs for the first 10 minutes.

Priya: Quick grep command if you want to check eviction logs:
```
journalctl -u redis-service --since "2024-03-25 00:00" | grep -i eviction | tail -n 200
```

Priya: Also added a short slide in /team/decks/dawn-ops (small bullet points + thresholds) — sharing for whoever takes next handoff.

Ravi: Thanks all. No immediate pager risk, just keep embeddings on the watchlist and ping infra if thresholds breach. I'll post final handoff at 15:50 UTC with any updates. :white_check_mark:

Avery: noted, will report back if I see anything odd after the PR merge. :thumbsup:

Priya: noted. I'll set the temporary alert and hand it over to whoever is on from 00:00–08:00 (cover rota in deck).

Jun: Leaving a sticky: check autoscaler logs if frontend 502s recur — suspect warmup/priming.

Ravi: Final: nothing else outstanding. Backchannel if needed.
